scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @vikipat/domain && npm run build -w @vikipat/pricing-engine
scripts.test:pricing: npm run build -w @vikipat/domain && npm run test -w @vikipat/pricing-engine
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @vikipat/storefront && npm run build -w @vikipat/admin && npm run build -w @vikipat/api
